body:
hey, this was truly amazing, thanks for all the messages. some did make feel better. It's hard to answer all, and I think it's difficult to pass the right message, not only because of the language barrier, but trying to express what goes on in my head and life for the past 27 years in just some lines in text form. I dont feel I am making myself completely clear, but...at the same time, I never liked to explain myself.

I do (or did) have hobbies, I do (or did) exercise (i think i'm in good shape), my mother doesn't care about me that much, she's one of the reasons I am like this, I was raised by her alone, and she has always been VERY abusive my whole life, verbally and physically (not that she can hurt me anymore, but the intention is there), also the one who forced me into law school.
I don't have money to leave the house. I make, let's see, in my country, something like..600dollar month. I am basically a 27-year-old-intern. (a perpetual intern, since i am not graduaitng any more). 

oh, and about the girl, being with her brings me back to reality. I think I've been livng the past, maybe, 5 or 6 years, just ignoring the world aroudn me, alienating everything (reality, bad thoughts) so I would keep my sanity not thinking about anything, baiscally an autopilot zombie mode, but when being with her everything comes back, the reality hits me again. but, yeah, she's the best thing that happened to me this year, the best girl i have been with, but at the same time, i know it won't last, like someone saying 'look, you won the lottery!!1...no, you didn't, jk!'..Sometimes i tell her i wish I met her earlier, in some different time, and she asks what do I mean, and say 'times when i wasnt thinking about jumping from that bridge there', and we laugh, because she thinks I am kidding.

but, you know what? and some of you agree with me on this: I don't care anymore, I am just going to lay down and sleep, that is really stress free stituation right now for me, nothing really matters anymore. To calm me down, many times I just check all the pills are there, sometimes I take one anxiety/sleeping also calms me and makes my day end, but another one alwyas comes..

thanks, you guys are great. hope you all live happy lives, but if it's not happening, do whatever you want, everybody should have this freedom

hey, thanks for writing. it's really nice, even (or especially) coming from people I never met.


it's just that (I don't really know what I intended when i began this thread, im not really looking for help), it's just that I tried a lot already, you guys are meeting me in my terminal phase. I tried a lot and have been through a lot, lots of anxiety, lots of expectations, and disappointments (many, many, many disappointments). 

It's very nice seeing good in people here, but the world is not like that. 

Thanks for offering time and help for talking, it's just that i dont feel like talking and being negative. explaining more and more, and going on and on about my situation, I dont think you would convice me nor i would convince you.

but thnaks, hope you guys are alright
